documentation:
The main popup view for the material configuration feature that allows users to import material data into the DB. Popup is opened from the AssetConfig view when selected on a site asset.

Input Data:
-dataSourceSelection Message Handler on the root: Message sent from the SelectDataSource view
-attributeSelection Message Handler on the root: Message sent from the MapMaterialAttributes view

Output Data:
-Import button on the last pane will send the selected data to the backend to store to the database

Custom Properties:
-custom.data.currentPane: determines which pane of the custom carousel it makes visible
-custom.data.selection.attributeSelection: updated from the attributeSelection message handler on the root and stores the user's attribute selections
-custom.data.selection.dataSourceSelection: updated from the dataSourceSelection message handler on the root and stores the user's data source selection
-custom.data.nextPaneReady: determines if all selections have been made and if the user can proceed to the next pane in the carousel
-custom.data.finalData: formats what the data will look like and displays this on the preview pane (last pane)
